summary: All three round-2 findings re-derived as closed on a clone of 012a266: the skip is git-scoped and the package-edit-repack loop is open again, both halves of it now bite under mutation (deleting the skip and reverting it to [ -e ] each redden the gate), and 'git checkout HEAD -- dist/' verifiably clears a staged rewrite. The fix commit introduces no blocking problem; two advisory Minors — a done-record bullet whose causal claim the fix falsified, and the gate's deliberate mutate-and-restore of the real dist/ whose backup the EXIT trap owns.
